from build123d import *
import math

def build(params):
    W = params["width"]
    bd = params["base_depth"]; bt = params["base_thickness"]
    ang = params["angle"]; tilt = math.radians(90.0 - ang)
    rl = params["rest_length"]; rt = params["rest_thickness"]
    lh = params["lip_height"]; lt = params["lip_thickness"]
    seat = params["seat_depth"]; st = params["strut_thickness"]
    d = math.radians(params["draft"])

    base = Box(bd, W, bt, align=(Align.MIN, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    hl = bt + lh
    lip_prof = Polygon((0, 0), (lt, 0), (lt - hl * math.tan(d), hl), (0, hl), align=None)
    lip = Pos(0, W / 2 + 1, 0) * extrude(Plane.XZ * lip_prof, W + 2)

    x0 = lt + seat
    rest = Pos(x0, 0, bt) * Rot(0, 90.0 - ang, 0) * Box(rt, W + 2, rl, align=(Align.MIN, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    c = math.cos(tilt)
    zg = bt + params["strut_height_ratio"] * rl * c
    qx = x0 + rt / c + (zg - bt) * math.tan(tilt) - 0.5
    px = bd - params["strut_inset"]
    phi = math.atan2(px - qx, zg - bt)
    hs = st / math.cos(phi)
    strut_prof = Polygon((px - hs, bt - 0.5), (px, bt - 0.5), (qx + hs / 2, zg), (qx - hs / 2, zg), align=None)
    strut = Pos(0, W / 2 + 1, 0) * extrude(Plane.XZ * strut_prof, W + 2)

    env_h = bt + rl + 10
    envelope = extrude(Rectangle(bd, W, align=(Align.MIN, Align.CENTER)), env_h, taper=params["draft"])

    stand = (base + lip + rest + strut) & envelope
    return {
        "parts": {"stand": stand},
        "features": [
            {"tag": "stand", "part": "stand", "tools": [base]},
            {"tag": "front_lip", "part": "stand", "tools": [lip]},
            {"tag": "back_rest", "part": "stand", "tools": [rest]},
            {"tag": "rear_strut", "part": "stand", "tools": [strut]},
            {"tag": "drafted_outline", "part": "stand", "tools": [envelope]},
        ],
        "materials": {"stand": "molded ABS"},
    }
